News.title: Brit dad-of-two, 34, dies after ‘brutal & unprovoked’ attack on vacation at holiday hotspot as family pay tribute
News.content:
Brit dad-of-two, 34, dies after ‘brutal & unprovoked’ attack on vacation at holiday hotspot as family pay tribute

A BRIT dad has died after suffering a “brutal and unprovoked” attack at a holiday hotspot, prompting a heartrending tribute from his family.

Scot James, 34, sustained devastating head injuries and spent 13 days in a hospital in Turkey, with his relatives setting up a GoFundMe to extend their stay.



A family friend reported that Scot had suffered a fractured skull and bleeds to the brain.

The fit and healthy rugby player – who played for Maesteg Celtic RFC near Bridgend in South Wales – was declared braindead on July 11.



He was flown home via air ambulance with his mother by his side and later transferred to the ICU in the Royal Glamorgan hospital.

His family described Scot as a “loving father, son, grandson and partner” and an “all-round loveable man”.



Sister Hannah said: “Peacefully with all his loved ones around him my beloved brother Scot passed away.

“We as a family got to spend and cherish his last few days with Scot and be by his bedside.

“But sadly yesterday afternoon Scot decided it was his time to go and us as a family was there to hold his hand while his life support was turned off and while he sadly passed away.”

She described the attack as “murder” and said the family would make sure the “perpetrator gets what he deserves for killing Scot.”

The family raised £7,500 on GoFundMe to extend their stay in Turkey, but issued an update following the tragic news about Scot’s condition.



Hannah said: “I’m giving you this update as initially this was set up to help cover the cost of the family staying out in Turkey.

“But as I’ve explained the circumstances have changed and now Scot has passed away.”

His local rugby club – which hosted a football tournament to raise funds for Scot – paid tribute on social media.

“We are deeply saddened to share the heart-breaking news that our former player, Scot James, sadly passed away yesterday,” said Maesteg Celtics RFC on Facebook.

“Everyone at the club is devastated by this news, and our thoughts go out to his family and friends at this difficult time.”



They added that Scot would be remembered as an “outstanding player” and a “friend to everyone”.

The Foreign Office have confirmed they are working with local authorities following Scot’s death.

An FCDO spokesperson said: “We are supporting the family of a British national who died following an incident in Turkey and are in contact with the local authorities”.

An inquest is due to be opened by the South Wales coroner.

News.title: Jodi Jones’s murderer Luke Mitchell pictured in cuffs as he’s released from prison to attend mum’s funeral
News.content:
EVIL murderer Luke Mitchell was let out of jail to attend his mum’s funeral chained to a prison guard.

The blade fiend, 36, caged for life for slaying his 14-year-old girlfriend Jodi Jones in 2003, embraced supporters as he arrived from high-security Shotts nick to say farewell to mother Corinne, 66.



Her passing was kept a closely-guarded secret amid fears it could have scuppered the killer’s chance to be at her funeral at Edinburgh’s Mortonhall Crematorium.

It’s thought to be the first time in over a decade Mitchell – who was refused parole in 2024 – has been pictured in public.



He was comforted by partner Gemma Chapman as a prison guard held him in handcuffs.

Balding and bearded Mitchell walked with his head down as he exited the small Pentland chapel with around a dozen mourners at around midday.



There was nothing on the daily list pinned on the wall to indicate who was being laid to rest during the 45-minute ceremony which was described as a “private service”.

Dressed in a black T-shirt and jeans, Mitchell shuffled mournfully, clutching an order of service as he followed Gemma – wearing a leather jacket and blue jeans – outside into the sunlight.

Gemma, with a blonde streak in her long dark hair, walked beside a female prison officer with Luke a few steps behind before she turned to face her infamous fella.

They embraced and held each other for a lingering cuddle, knowing he would soon be back in his jail cell.



An onlooker said: “I had no idea it was Luke Mitchell until I spotted the prison guard and handcuffs.



“What he did to poor Jodi was horrific and who knows if he’ll ever see freedom again.

“When he got jailed he was just a teenager and he looks very different today with that baldy head and beard.

“He spent a good while hugging a dark-haired woman and other mourners.

“He looked sorry for himself when he was being taken back to a blacked-out people carrier by the prison officers.”

Earlier in the day Corinne’s coffin travelled alone from a nearby funeral home in a black horse and carriage, with nothing to reveal her identity to onlookers.



White lillies were placed inside the carriage and a discreet floral tribute at the foot of her casket simply said ‘mum’.

Other supporters – who remain convinced Mitchell didn’t murder his teen girlfriend Jodi – were also seen offering their condolences.



Some wore badges pledging support for the campaign to have Mitchell liberated with one older lady seen wrapping her arms around the killer.

Within an hour of Mitchell being hauled back to Shotts jail his backers posted a message on social media revealing Corine had died.

It read: “It is with great sadness that we share the news that Corinne Mitchell passed away on July 9, 2026.

“Corinne was laid to rest following a private service surrounded by the people who love her.



“Many of you came to know of Corinne through her unwavering love and support for her son, Luke.

“Those who knew Corinne also knew that she was a devoted mother who loved both of her sons beyond measure.

“Despite her own health challenges, she remained determined, resilient and full of strength.

“Her humour, kindness and unwavering spirit touched the lives of so many.

“Although Corinne is no longer with us, her spirit will remain.”



They added: “Her determination to see justice done will not be forgotten.”

Sick Mitchell was just was 14 when he stabbed Jodi to death in woods near her home in 2003.

He was later sentenced to serve a minimum term of 20 years before being eligible for parole.

He had been dating Jodi for four months when he killed her in what judge Lord Nimmo Smith later described as “a truly evil murder”.

Mitchell claimed to have been alerted to her body by his dog while out looking for her.



Jodi was discovered with her hands tied behind her back, her throat cut and her body repeatedly slashed.

Following a ten-month police inquiry, Mitchell was accused of her murder and was 16 when he was convicted at the High Court in Edinburgh in 2005.

He has lost multiple appeals but has attracted a significant following of online supporters convinced of his innocence since a TV documentary was aired in 2021.

Mitchell’s mother Corinne and others have campaigned for more than 20 years to have the killer released.

In their statement, the campaign group added: “Finally, to Luke, we hope you know that you are not alone.



“There are many people who continue to stand beside you, and who will honour your mother’s memory by continuing to seek the truth. May Corinne rest in peace.”

We told in March last year Mitchell and Gemma got engaged behind bars. According to a report at the time it was claimed she had been campaigning for Mitchell’s release for the past 20 years.

She insists he was wrongly accused and says he is “kind, caring and loving”.

A source told a newspaper that Mitchell popped the question in November, 2024, after he was returned to high-security Shotts jail in Lanarkshire when he failed two random drug tests at HMP Greenock.

They said at the time: “He asked the prison permission and did it.



“His parole condition, if he got it, would only permit him to be with named women.”

Mitchell was earlier denied parole after a psychiatric report concluded he was a “sexual risk” to women.

He claimed his dog led him to Jodi’s body in woods in Dalkeith.

Her hands were tied behind her back and her throat was cut. Prosecutors told Mitchell’s 2005 trial he was obsessed with Satanism.

Mitchell, then 16, was convicted in what judge Lord Nimmo Smith called “a truly evil murder”.

News.title: ‘Streetwise’ wallaby on the run across UK countryside for three years – but vanishes ‘like a ghost’ to escape capture
News.content:
A WALLABY that “vanishes like a ghost” when spotted has spent the last three years on the loose across the UK countryside.

Local zookeeper Danny Reynolds said the wallaby – which has adjusted to its wild life in the rolling hills of Devon – is infamously hard to capture.



“It’s far too streetwise now and has obviously been chased a number of times before,” he said.

“We tried when it was nearer our premises to catch it, putting teams out with net sweeps and even went out with dart guns, but as soon as it sees you or it hears any noise, it’s gone.



“It doesn’t belong in an enclosed environment now, it’s enjoying itself out there.”

The vagrant marsupial – native to Australia – is not the first to have ended up thousands of miles from its home turf.



Populations have also been spotted in Hertfordshire and Gateshead by startled locals, with this sighting in Devon being the latest.

Vicky, 57, was on her way back from an appointment on June 21 in Barnstaple when she spotted the wallaby – but said it seemed totally unfazed by the encounter.



“I was so close to it and I moved every time it moved, but when I stopped it would just look at me, and I didn’t think it was afraid or anything,” said the interior designer.

She added: “It was mad, absolutely mad.”

“As I turned the corner, I thought, ‘oh my gosh, what is that?'”

At first, she suspected it was a rabbit before suddenly realising it was a wallaby.

“I thought ‘no one is going to believe that I’ve seen a wallaby trotting down the road in the middle of North Devon‘,” she said.



“I then opened the door and got out of the car but there was no way I was going to be able to catch it.

“After a while, he just trotted off and jumped into the hedge.”

She said that it appeared very well fed given how long it had been out in the wild.

Zookeeper Danny believes the wallaby has likely adjusted to its wild life out the hills.

He said: “The winters have warmed up so much now and become a lot wetter and less cold.



“This particular individual seems to like staying in dense undergrowth and forest, so it’s making a good living eating bramble and all the bits that survive through the winter.”

He added that while it may be alone in the countryside, it is not necessarily “sad or in need of company”.

“It has come in to our proximity here at the zoo before, but it’s quite happy to be out there, and it doesn’t particularly spend any time with us, so if it was looking for companionship, it would stay nearer to our premises,” he said.

News.title: Long-lost UK burial tomb as old as the PYRAMIDS is finally exposed after 5,000 years in huge breakthrough
News.content:
GROUND BREAKING Long-lost UK burial tomb as old as the PYRAMIDS is finally exposed after 5,000 years in huge breakthrough

A LONG-LOST tomb as ancient as the Pyramids has been exposed by the UK’s scorching heatwaves.

Incredible shots taken from above reveal the outline of the 5000-year-old burial mound, once used by ancient Britons.



The mound would have served as a communal burial site and sacred gathering space during the neolithic age, the final phase of the Stone Age.

It is believed bodies were left outside of the barrow to decompose, before the cleaned bones were moved inside the stone chambers.



Aerial archaeologist Dr Toby Driver spotted the barrow in the parched landscape of Welshpool in mid-Wales.

Toby described the image as a “remarkable” cropmark of a “rectangular Neolithic long barrow” dating back several millenia.

According to the Royal Commission on the Ancient and Historical Monuments of Wales, its size can be determined by the tractor lines in the field.

Expert Toby said he has been trying to keep track of the finds during the heatwaves.



“We used to wait five to seven years for a record heatwave summer for aerial archaeology, but now they come around every other year,” he said.

“This year has been pretty windy across Wales, so some of the longer trips to record cropmarks have made for challenging flying.”

He said that the cropmarks tend to jump out as the aircraft orbits around the site.

“But some parts of Wales are now so dry that the cropmarks can be faint and pretty hard to see,” he added.

“In these cases, we digitally rebalance the colour bands of the image, really making the archaeology ‘pop’ and reveal previously hidden details – these images appear as black and white.”



The Commission collaborates with pilots at FlyWales, Haverfordwest, and Caernarfon Airport to track cropmarks across Wales during the dry weather.

The blazing heat in Wales between April and July has exposed several other lost archaeological sites in the fields.

Previously “invisible” monuments, including forts, Roman buildings and even First World War practice trenches have been revealed in the scorched grasslands.

The National Monuments Record of Wales is archiving the photographs, which will be available to inspect for decades to come.

Toby said he also recorded an unidentified Iron Age or Romano-British farmstead in Llandysul on the west coast of Wales.

News.title: Putin’s ‘doomsday radio’ crackles into life and broadcasts mystery codewords after Vlad’s missile bombs Poland
News.content:
PUTIN’S notorious Doomsday Radio crackled into life with a chilling barrage of mystery codewords after a suspected Russian missile smashed into NATO territory in Poland.

The eerie Cold War relic suddenly spewed out at least nine cryptic messages as two girls, aged five and 12, were among those killed in the strikes.



Among the bizarre ciphers broadcast on the frequency were BRIBETAKER, SEXFAT or SEXOFAT, MONARCHIST, MOTEL, MUZOPAYUS, STEPENNY and LEVRETKA.

One chilling message included KLETKA, meaning “CELL”, while another used NEDOTEPA, roughly translating as “DIMWIT”.



The sinister flurry of activity came as NATO scrambled fighter jets after the mystery missile crossed into Polish airspace during a savage Russian assault on Ukraine.

Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk said: “It looks like it was a Russian missile, but we don’t have 100 per cent certainty exactly what kind of missile.”

The suspected strike left a huge 33ft-wide crater near Tarnawa-Kolonia, around 56 miles from the Ukrainian border.

But as tensions spiralled, Russia’s mysterious UVB-76 radio station was busy transmitting its own baffling barrage.

Also known ominously as The Buzzer, Dead Hand Radio and Judgement Day Radio, UVB-76 broadcasts continuously on 4625 kHz.

For most of the time, listeners hear nothing but an eerie, repetitive buzzing sound.



But when a message is transmitted, the ghostly buzz suddenly cuts out.

A Russian-speaking operator then reads out strange sequences of words, numbers and letters which sound like complete gobbledegook to anyone listening in.

The meaning of the coded messages remains guarded and the station’s precise purpose has never been officially disclosed.



Yet UVB-76 is widely believed to be linked to the Russian military and potentially forms part of a strategic command-and-control network.

That has fuelled the chilling theory that the station could be used to send secret instructions to military units without relying on modern communications.

Its high-frequency signal can travel huge distances by bouncing through the ionosphere, meaning it can cover much of Russia without satellites or the internet.

Last year, the soviet-era relic broadcasted a cryptic message around the same time of Vladimir Putin’s telephone call with Donald Trump.

Just ahead of the White House’s call to Putin, the UVB-76 radio station broadcast the sinister code NZhTI 89905 BLEFOPUF 4097 5573.



This was followed up a few hours later with NZhTI 01263 BOLTANKA 4430 9529.

Electronic warfare expert Professor David Stupples, who first heard about the mysterious frequency in the 1990s, said: “It’s a military source. So we do know that. And we know where the transmitters are in Russia.”

He told The Sun the signal’s ability to travel without satellites could make it especially valuable if conventional communications were knocked out.



Stupples said: “The high-frequency communications will probably get through.”

That has sparked the terrifying theory that the station could serve as an emergency communications lifeline during a nuclear conflict.

The expert said that in the event of a devastating nuclear war, Russia’s normal communications infrastructure could be crippled while the high-frequency signal continued operating.

He explained that the system could allow Moscow to broadcast instructions across Russia even if satellite communications were lost.

The chilling possibility has also fuelled its nickname Dead Hand Radio, amid speculation that it could form part of a “dead man’s switch” designed to help trigger a Russian military response if the country’s leadership were wiped out.



There is no official confirmation that UVB-76 performs such a role.

Stupples believes the station’s constant buzzing may instead have a far more practical purpose – reserving the frequency for Russia.

He explained: “The only way that you can make certain that the band is available is to keep broadcasting on it.”

He added: “So what Russia is doing is reserving this frequency.”

The expert said his “own speculation” was that Moscow could be keeping the channel available for emergencies, including a worldwide conflict involving nuclear weapons or the loss of satellite communications.



UVB-76 has been broadcasting since the late 1970s, making it one of the world’s most enduring and baffling radio mysteries.

Its transmitters are understood to be positioned around Russia, including locations outside Moscow and St Petersburg, while its high-frequency signal can be picked up across vast distances.

The station’s strange bursts of activity have often coincided with periods of acute international tension, further deepening its sinister reputation.



And the latest barrage comes as Putin’s war threatens to spill ever closer to NATO’s doorstep.

The suspected missile incursion happened during a ferocious Russian assault in which more than 70 missiles and 280 attack drones were reportedly launched at Ukraine.

Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said: “A Russian missile strike in Radushne, Dnipropetrovsk region, killed parents and three children.”

The Kremlin has repeatedly threatened retaliation against the West, while Poland’s Foreign Minister Radosław Sikorski has warned Putin could stage a “false flag” attack on Russian territory and blame NATO.
